attacks.name: Plasma Rifle
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
If the defender is within |!range| 3, this character may reroll up to 2 dice in the attack roll.
|!wild| |*Incinerate|: After this attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§incinerate§Incinerate| special condition.

attacks.name: Askani‘Son
steps: After each attack is resolved, if it dealt |!damage|, remove 1 |!damage| from this character.

superPowers.name: Wetworks (Affiliation: X-Force)
superPowers.body: Each allied character may reroll 1 die in their attack rolls once per Turn, including |!failure| results. If they do and the enemy character is within |!range| 3, the enemy character does not benefit from Cover during the attack.

superPowers.name: Body Slide by One
superPowers.body: Place this character within |!range| 2 of its current position. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Omega Level Threat
superPowers.body: This character may spend 1 to 4 |!power| to use this superpower. Choose an interactive terrain feature within |!range| 3 with a Size equal to or less than the |!power| spent to use this superpower. Throw the chosen terrain feature |!range_medium|. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Telekinetic Shield
superPowers.body: When this character or an allied character within |!range| 3 of this character is targeted by an attack, this character may use this superpower. Add 2 dice to the target character's defense roll against this attack.

superPowers.name: Techno-Organic Virus Suppression
superPowers.body: During the |*Power Phase|, this character gains 1 additional |!power|.

erratas.body: Stamina increased from 7 to 8 on Injured side.
Stamina increased from 6 to 7 on Healthy side.
A special rule was added to "Plasma Rifle", allowing to reroll up to 2 dice in the attack roll.
Power cost for "Askani‘Son" decreased from 6 to 5. That attack loses the capacity to Stagger on the Injured side.
"Wetworks" now allows to reroll |!failure| results. Using the Leadership also allows to ignore Cover under conditions.
